commitMessage: fix: add fused_mrope and vision_embedding_merge to OpTraitTable
notes: Focused DSP training parity passed after enabling training freeze/replay semantics. Logs show first execution frozen=false, then TrainingSession freezes shapes, FROZEN_TRANSITION fires, and subsequent executions run frozen=true. This verifies the requested non-slot-by-slot training behavior for stable batch shapes in the focused gate.
